newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Seven minutes of freedom for 14-year convict.
newsitem.headline: Seven minutes of freedom for 14-year convict.

text.p: Argentine Daniel Trillo enjoyed only seven minutes of freedom after serving a 14-year prison sentence for murder before he was arrested again.
Trillo had time to walk 200 yards (metres) from the prison gates in the Patagonian town of Rawson on Sunday before police nabbed him on a charge of possessing a stolen compact disc player.
An informer had told police that Trillo received stolen goods while in jail, the state-owned Telam news agency reported.
